record: Study 4b settings: forecasting the change in category demand and catching rare surges, books first. Fixed before any 4b forecast was made or scored.
fixed_by: Khant Phyo Wai (with Claude); agreed in chat on 2026-10-14
relation_to_study4: Study 4 stays reported as run (interest did not improve one-month-ahead level forecasts). Study 4b is a new, separately fixed study that changes the target, the horizon and the scoring after Study 4's result was known (disclosed below).

units.eligibility: the Study 3 minimum-size rule at the origin, as in Study 4

part_a_change_forecasts.target: change in log share, d(t+h) - d(t); the forecast of the level is d(t) + predicted change
part_a_change_forecasts.catboost: iterations 600, depth 6, learning_rate 0.05, loss RMSE, random_seed 20261013, thread_count per Study 4

feature_sets.D+W: plus the Study 4 Wikipedia interest features
feature_sets.D+W+S: plus Study 3 knowledge known at the origin: (1) a sustained Wikipedia shift (labelled sustained by its fourth week) started in the 8 weeks before the origin; (2) the category's responsiveness = mean Study 3 synthetic-control effect of its earlier shifts whose effect window (months 0 to +2) ended on or before the origin, 0 when none

part_a_change_forecasts.scheme: walk-forward by month with an expanding window, retrained at every origin; test origins 2019-01 to the last origin with a target month
part_a_change_forecasts.metrics: MAE of the level; skill = 1 - MAE(new) / MAE(base); Diebold-Mariano one-sided (Newey-West lag 3); moving-block bootstrap (block 3, 2,000, seed 20261013)
part_a_change_forecasts.helps_rule: interest helps if CatBoost D+W (or D+W+S) beats CatBoost D at the primary horizon with skill > 0, bootstrap interval above zero and DM p < 0.05, for print and ebook pooled at each level; each model is also compared with zero change

part_b_surges.surge: change in log share d(t+h) - d(t) >= log(1.3) for an eligible category-format at horizon h (primary h = 2)
part_b_surges.models: CatBoost classifier (logloss, same tree settings) and logistic regression, feature sets D, D+W, D+W+S
part_b_surges.metrics: average precision (primary); recall among the 10 highest-scored category-formats per origin and format; Brier score; the base rate is reported
part_b_surges.inference: moving-block bootstrap of the average-precision difference D+W(+S) minus D (block 3 months, 2,000, seed 20261013); helps if the 95% interval is above zero
showcases: Race and racism, print and ebook, origin April 2020 (target June 2020)
Epidemics and plagues, ebook, origin January 2020 (target March 2020)

disclosures: Known before fixing: Study 3 and 3b results (sustained shifts carry over about 9 to 11% over 3 months; peak 2 to 3 months after the start), Study 4 results (no gain at horizon 1; +1.4% at horizon 2, not significant; CatBoost worse than naive), and the Study 1 label check.
The choice of horizon 2 as primary and of a change target follows from those results; Study 4b is therefore a second, informed test, not a replication.
